title: credclock — CAQH and credential expiry tracker for small clinics
oneLiner: For owners and managers of 1–10 clinician practices, it tracks each clinician's license, DEA and malpractice expiry plus the 120-day CAQH clock and flags documents that will block the next attestation, at a flat price instead of per-provider fees.
overlaps: none — closest repo is RepoHQ/Github-HQ (portfolio dashboard), which does not track credentials
